notes:
Speaker communication is now three layers, and the sixteen commands have tests.

TRANSFER NO LONGER FLASHES THE ZONES AS GROUPED. A transfer groups the destination onto the source, waits for audio to sync, then has the source step aside — so for about 2.5 seconds the zones really are grouped, and the timed topology refresh reported it truthfully about two times in five. The timed refresh now stands down for the duration, using a self-expiring deadline rather than a flag: a boolean cleared at the end of an async sequence is stranded permanently if that sequence dies, which is exactly how auto-lock got stuck on. The transfer's own closing refresh still runs, so the settled picture arrives a second later.

SONOSCOMMANDS AND SONOSSOAP. All sixteen speaker commands — transport, queue, share registration, grouping, volume — moved out of ZoneDiscoveryService (556 lines), then collapsed onto one shared SOAP builder (a further 233). ZoneDiscoveryService is 2,377 lines before this work began and about 1,500 now.

A LATENT SIXTY-SECOND HANG, FIXED. addURIToQueue and createObject set no timeout at all and inherited URLSession's 60-second default. Both run on the local-file path, so an unreachable speaker froze the start of an album for a full minute rather than failing in five seconds. Timeouts are now named — quick, action, bulk — in one table with the reason attached, instead of a spread of 3/5/10/none that nobody had chosen.

ELEVEN TESTS ON WHAT REACHES THE WIRE: right action, right service endpoint, right payload, sane timeout. Three mutations were killed proving they bite — a misrouted CreateObject, missing ampersand escaping, and a restored 60-second timeout. The last asserts the property rather than the two known cases, so no future command can reintroduce it. The fast suite is 58 tests in 1.3 seconds; the hosted suite is 143 with the four known scanner failures.

KNOWN AND UNCHANGED: the four scanner failures predate this work. Sequence-level tests — asserting the ORDER of the local playback commands rather than each one alone — remain unwritten and are logged as fLocalPlaybackSequenceTests along with the obstacle that blocks them.
